name: STAC Classification Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC Classification extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC Classification extension (classification:classes, classification:bitfields, and the Class Object / Bit Field Object fields), providing Linked Data terms for the STAC Classification schema. classification:Class is modeled as a skos:Concept subclass since each classes/bitfields entry is a dataset-specific codelist entry; the codelist containers and per-class statistics stay OWL. Reuses STAC core classes rather than redefining them.
